site_name: CROWN AND NEW BALTIC, PARK AND BRIDGE AND VICTORIA WHARVES, BOUNDED BY GROVE STREET,  DRAGOON STREET AND EVELYN STREET, OXESTALLS ROAD, LONDON, SE8
description: An application submitted under Section 96a of the Town & Country Planning Act 1990 for a non-material amendment to planning permission ref: DC/19/110414 (dated 20 March 2019) for the approval of Reserved Matters for Plot 6 consisting of Blocks 6A, 6B and 6C (part Phase 3) facing Oxestalls Road and Grove Street, as amended by permission ref: DC/122/125291 (dated 22 February 2023). The application seeks to make the following amendments:Introduction of a cycle store within the Block A entrance lobby, replacing the approved residents' lounge to achieve the number of cycle parking spaces targeted across the Plot 6 and introduction of semi-opaque privacy film to space used as cycle storeIntroduction of a canopy over the ground-floor duplex entrance to Block C on the east elevationUpdates to plant area door formats on Blocks B and C (north, south and east elevations)Update to the main entrance door to meet manufacturer requirementsIntroduction of access gates to Block C ground-floor terraces on the west elevation
